item: Best Use of Render (sponsor, $1,000 / $750 / $500 in credits)
detail: Entered (2 Nov). Two Render services from one Blueprint: the web service with a disk for the SQLite ledger and a health check, and a Render Workflow (gig-money-workflows) that tags each new payment: tagPayment runs a classifyWithModel step, then classifyWithRules only if the model fails, each visible in the dashboard; the ledger row shows the run id. Secrets come from the vault by playbook; the model key is in env group gig-money-model. Live check 2 Nov: a sandbox payment was tagged by the model through the Workflow about 5 s after capture. SDK note: run.get() never returned against the live API, so the app polls the run status.
